120 columns x 32 rows | monospace 11 pt | fixed warm-up frame
UTF-8: Chinese 中文 | Japanese 日本語 | café | café
[31mred[0m [32mgreen[0m [34mblue[0m [38;2;230;150;60mtruecolor[0m
No scrolling or animation in the memory sample.
PTY completion is measured with cursor-position replies (DSR).

method.application_memory: sum smaps_rollup PSS and Private_Clean+Private_Dirty for every marked terminal process and helper, excluding known probe subtrees and isolated infrastructure
method.memory_aggregation: median of three process snapshots per run; median of three fresh-process runs per app
method.latency_aggregation: per-run p50/p95 across 10 x 300 measured DSR round trips; median of three run statistics
method.output_aggregation: median of three 1 MiB output bursts per window, then median of ten windows, then median of three runs
method.performance_scope: one focused window at a time, other nine idle; raw PTY write-to-DSR response; logical processing completion, not a physical rendering/scanout fence
method.cold_warm: fresh terminal processes and isolated config per run; memory sampled after fixed frame and font warm-up; OS page/font caches are not flushed
method.graphics_scope: Xvfb software rendering only; X-server PSS delta and XRes client pixmaps recorded separately; does not quantify native GPU/VRAM or desktop compositor behavior
method.window_visibility: all ten windows mapped and tiled without overlap on one private 7680x2160 X display
method.desktop_services: private EXTERNAL-authenticated D-Bus without service activation directories; GTK accessibility disabled; portal/accessibility desktop services are outside this isolated configuration
method.ordering: three app orders rotate by one app each repetition; only one app's ten windows run at a time
method.limitations: single machine, one grid/font/output pattern; history capacities have different units and histories remain empty; no real keyboard-to-photon claim
